import json, re, random, chess, time
rules = json.load(open("re.json"))
comp = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in rules]
def run(fen):
    for p, r in comp: fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]
def expected(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen); s = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN: continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
ex = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print(run(ex))
random.seed(1); n = 0; t = time.time()
for g in range(400):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 300:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE:
            fen = b.fen(); exp = expected(fen); ours = run(fen); n += 1
            ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0]+" -" in exp for x in ours)
            if not ok and exp:
                print("FAIL", fen, sorted(set(ours) - exp), sorted(exp - set(ours))); raise SystemExit
        ms = list(b.legal_moves)
        caps = [m for m in ms if b.is_capture(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(caps if caps and random.random() < 0.3 else ms))
print("ok", n, time.time() - t)
EOF
